title: Eagles owner Jeffrey Lurie: Have to do "exploratory research" about best stadium situation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eagles owner Jeffrey Lurie: Have to do "exploratory research" about best stadium situation
sources.description: The Eagles sent a letter to season ticket holders last year telling them that they were looking into options that included both "renovation options" for Lincoln Financial Field as well as "the possibility of a brand new stadium in the region."
